items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: I think Raymond Burke had one something like this too.

ctx.x: Well, I'll tell you. I believe you made a wonderful deal.

I only got part of it, of course. That's real ivory on it and funny old brass keys. Somebody told me once a story about Sid. Paul Barber and I believe talked about it. Once Sidney Bechet was going to play a parade or funeral uptown. He didn't have a clarinet that was usually in the pawn shop or something. So he went in the pawn shop and they got one of these old yellow ones. I think Raymond Burke had one something like this too. And they said it only had three or four keys on it. What other key?
